# DOSSIER X

> DOSSIER X is a document-driven detective investigation game played in the browser. Players analyze fictional case files — crime scene photos, evidence, suspect dossiers, and witness interviews — then name the culprit and earn a case-closed certificate. No hand-holding: the truth hides in the details.

DOSSIER X is a free web application. Players create a detective profile, open a case from the archive, and work through five investigation sections per case: the briefing, crime scene, evidence board, suspects, and witness statements. Solving a case correctly awards achievements and a printable certificate bearing the detective's name. Additional cases can be imported as downloadable "case packs".

All cases and characters are entirely fictional. The game is single-player and runs locally in the browser; no account is required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dossier-x.lovable.app/): Create your detective profile and begin your first investigation.
- [Case Archive](https://dossier-x.lovable.app/archive): Browse all available fictional criminal cases and open an investigation.
- [Case Packs](https://dossier-deconstructed.lovable.app/casepacks): Import additional downloadable investigation cases.
- [Achievements](https://dossier-deconstructed.lovable.app/achievements): Track investigation milestones and unlocked badges.
- [Certificates](https://dossier-deconstructed.lovable.app/certificates): View case-closed certificates earned by solving cases.

## Topics

- Detective game, murder mystery game, criminal investigation simulation
- Fictional case files, evidence analysis, deduction puzzles
- Browser-based single-player mystery experience
